message.ru: В заголовке указан винт 4.0 мм, в строке Diameter напечатано 3.5 мм. Оба исходных значения сохранены.
message.en: The title specifies 4.0 mm, while the Diameter line prints 3.5 mm. Both source values are retained.

flags.resolution: Owner explicitly authorized publication as printed. Original source issue retained internally; no catalog number or dimension has been inferred or changed.

review.imageQA: All source photos checked visually; native resolution corrected for rotations; Real-ESRGAN exact 2x, rembg, source-white aperture cleanup; originals retained.
review.publicationDecision: Owner explicitly requested publication of the five remaining Trauma Part 1 drafts as normal products; source values retained unchanged.
